reply.text:
This is one for your surgeon or physio, not a coach. Three weeks after knee surgery, whether squatting is safe is a call they need to make with your specific procedure and your recovery in front of them. Ask them directly when you can start loading the knee, and what range and load they want you to stay within.

Once they clear you, tell me what they said and I'll build the squat work around it. Until then, I can keep the rest of your training on the table: upper body, core, or planning the return so we start from a sensible place.
